name: Human (Variant)

traits.name: Ability Score Increase
traits.description: Two different ability scores of your choice increase by 1.

traits.name: Skills
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Feat
traits.description: You gain one feat of your choice.

text: An optional version of the human that replaces the standard ability score increase with two chosen increases, one extra skill and a feat at first level. Uses the human's other traits: speed 30 feet, Medium size, and one extra language.
